_om: Mistanken in English (Nosy, rusj.no/en/nosy/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The questions are in data.en/sporsmal.json. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Hold fingeren på kortet for å se: Hold your finger on the card to see
Mobilen hvisker et hemmelig spørsmål til: The phone whispers a secret question to one of you – ‘Who here …?’. The answer is a name. Everyone finds out who was picked, but not why.
Den som får mobilen, holder fingeren på: Whoever has the phone holds a finger on the card and reads the question. Then you tap a name – without saying the question out loud.
Den som ble pekt ut, kan ta en liten slu: The person picked can take a small sip – or say something nice about whoever answered. Then the phone flips a coin: 👁️ reveals the question, 🤫 keeps it secret.
Du trenger ikke å vite. Da forblir spørs: You don't have to know. The question stays secret, and the phone moves on to the next person.
Alkoholfritt teller like mye, og alle ka: Alcohol-free counts just as much, and anyone can sit a round out – no explanation needed.
Spørsmålene er snille. Er et spørsmål fe: The questions are kind. If one is wrong for your crew, tap ‘Swap question’.
Every tenth round is a water break.
Spis og drikk vann underveis, og sørg fo: Eat and drink water as you go, and make sure everyone gets home safely.
‘Who here …?’ – you answer with a name.
Mobilen går rundt i samme rekkefølge som: The phone goes round in the same order as the list.
A sip is a small sip – never more.
Vil du vite spørsmålet, kan du si noe hy: To find out the question, you can say something nice instead of drinking.
